## Blank template

**Meeting/date/participants:** [ ]
**Purpose:** [ ]

### Decisions and follow-up

**Decisions and rationale:** [IDs; what was decided and why]
**Actions:** [ID, owner, due date, dependency, evidence of done]
**Unresolved questions:** [ID, consequence, next check, decision date]
**Risks or escalation:** [ID, owner and trigger]
**Explicitly not decided:** [ ]
**Next meeting or review trigger:** [ ]

## Completed example

**Decision D-014:** Seek privacy advice before ethics submission because partner-led contact may reveal eligibility.
**Action A-031:** Student books consultation by Friday; evidence is calendar confirmation.
**Not decided:** final recruitment channel.
**Next review:** after consultation note is available.

## Scenario test

If participants remember a discussion differently, the record reveals the actual decision and invites timely factual correction without recreating a transcript.

## Privacy boundary

Record the project's decisions and progress here. Keep sensitive personal or case details in the appropriate confidential process.
